name: Habsburg Mining Expedition
title: Habsburg Mining Expedition
pressure_shape: Mining lands (3+ Invaders) Ravage on Build Cards; Explorer upgrades after each Build Step (L3, L5), Salt Deposits card (L4), extra Explorers on Explore (L6); loses at 8+ Invaders/Blight in one land at the end of the Fast Phase.

stage_ii_escalation.title: Mining Tunnels
stage_ii_escalation.text: After Advancing Invader Cards: On each board, Explore in 2 lands whose terrains don't match a Ravage or Build Card (no source required).

loss_condition.title: Land Stripped Bare
loss_condition.text: At the end of the Fast Phase, the Invaders win if any land has at least 8 total Invaders/Blight (combined).

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (HabsburgMiningExpedition), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.8 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Mining Tunnels): After Advancing Invader Cards: On each board, Explore in 2 lands whose terrains don't match a Ravage or Build Card (no source required). Additional loss condition (Land Stripped Bare): At the end of the Fast Phase, the Invaders win if any land has at least 8 total Invaders/Blight (combined).

levels.name: Avarice Rewarded + Ceaseless Mining
levels.escalation: Avarice Rewarded: When Blight added by a Ravage Action would cascade, instead Upgrade 1 Explorer/Town (before Dahan counterattack). Ceaseless Mining: Lands with 3 or more Invaders are Mining lands. In Mining lands: • Disease and modifiers to Disease affect Ravage Actions as though they were Build Actions. • During the Build Step, Build Cards cause Ravage Actions (instead of Build Actions).

levels.name: Miners Come From Far and Wide
levels.escalation: Setup: Add 1 Explorer in each land with no Dahan. On each board, Add 1 Disease and 1 City in the highest-numbered land with a Town Setup symbol.
levels.notes: R-ADV-HME-L2. 'On each board' per the FAQ errata (NQ-B); Brett's panel image prints the text without it.

levels.name: Mining Boom (I)
levels.escalation: After the Build Step, on each board: Choose a land with Explorer. Upgrade 1 Explorer there.

levels.name: Untapped Salt Deposits
levels.escalation: Setup: Remove the Stage II “Coastal Lands” card before randomly choosing Stage II cards. Place the “Salt Deposits” card in place of the 2nd Stage II card. (New Deck Order: 111-2S22-33333, where S is the Salt Deposits card. Escalation ignores S.)
levels.notes: R-ADV-HME-L4. Salt Deposits cannot be Accelerated out; discard the next Stage II card (or the top-most Stage III) instead (FAQ; NQ-E).

levels.name: Mining Boom (II)
levels.escalation: Instead of Mining Boom (I), after the Build Step, on each board: Choose a land with Explorer. Build there, then Upgrade 1 Explorer. (Build normally in a Mining land.)

levels.name: The Empire Ascendant
levels.escalation: Setup and During the Explore Step: On boards with 3 or fewer Blight, Add +1 Explorer in each land successfully explored. (Max. 2 lands per board per Explore Card.)
